newsitem.title: USA: Watermarc sells Pete's Hospitality unit.
newsitem.headline: Watermarc sells Pete's Hospitality unit.

text.p: Watermarc Food Management Co said Monday that it has sold its Pete's Hospitality Co Inc subsidiary to Angelo Pitillo, Watermarc's former president and chief operating officer.
Terms of the transaction were not dislosed.

The company said that the sale was made in keeping with its strategy of geographically concentrating its restaurant operations in the Texas area, and franchising its core concepts, which include 17 Original Pasta Co restaurants and 23 Marco's restaurants.
Pete's Hospitality operates two Pete's Barbecue restaurants and the H.D. Hotspurs restaurant and lounge, all located in the Seattle area.
